content: Russian akt priyoma-peredachi practice: two copies (employer+employee); required requisites: organization name, date+place, full names and positions of both parties, item name with characteristics (model, serial, inventory number, cost), condition at handover, completeness, signatures of both sides. Full material responsibility only for specific roles under art.244 TK RF with separate contract; others limited to average monthly salary (art.241). Act fixes fact of transfer and return-in-good-condition obligation; free form allowed (e-kontur, assistentus, glavbukh).
